limitations: This finding does not establish whether the wider public believed Altman.

criteria.contradiction_condition: No reliable binary contradiction condition exists without knowing the reactions on which Marcus based his impression. Finding believers elsewhere does not by itself contradict what he could tell from the material he saw.
